Requirement: "Update the header comment, `_summarize_final_merge_blockers` and the operator hint text so they list only success/neutral/skipped as acceptable."
Expected change site: `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2609`, `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:126`, `prompts/_templates/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:119`
Evidence of absence: The PR updates the gate function's header comment (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:132-149`), `_summarize_final_merge_blockers` (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1615-1656`), and the operator hint text at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1572`. The three explicit sites from the issue are covered. But three additional sites carry the same "success/neutral/skipped/cancelled" wording that contradicts the new gate semantics: `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2609` (operator warning emitted by the review-blocked judge when the gate blocks the merge), `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:126` (review-blocked judge prompt), and `prompts/_templates/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:119` (review-blocked judge prompt template). After this PR, the gate blocks on cancelled required runs but these three sites still tell operators and the judge model that cancelled is acceptable — the operator warning will read "still pending until checks complete with success/neutral/skipped/cancelled" on a PR the gate has already refused, and the judge prompt's documentation of the gate contract is wrong. Both functions actively invoke the shared `_pr_checks_completed` gate (review_rb_judge.sh:2593).
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
